name: composer
description: Message composer: a textarea that grows with its text to a maximum number of lines and then scrolls (CSS field-sizing with a measured fallback), Enter to send and Shift+Enter for a new line — never mid-IME-composition — a send button that is live only when there is something to send, an action slot (emoji, voice), and file attachments from a picker, a paste or a drop, shown as removable chips. Sending emits a cancelable faqir:send with the text and the files, then clears and refocuses.

attachments.description: The tray of attached files, above the bar: role='list' with an aria-label and aria-live='polite', hidden while empty. The controller renders one chip primitive per file (role='listitem', the name and size as the label, a 'Remove {name}' dismiss button); removing one moves focus to the next chip, or to the attach button.

bar.description: The row: the field, then the send button.

field.description: The rounded well that holds the action buttons, the textarea and the attach button. It carries the focus ring for everything inside it.

action.description: Optional icon button(s) in the field — emoji picker, camera, voice note. Each a real button with an aria-label; what it opens is the page's.

input.description: The message textarea, with an aria-label naming the conversation. Grows from one line to --composer-max-lines (default 6), then scrolls.

attach.description: Opens the hidden file picker. A button with an aria-label ('Attach files').

file.description: The hidden <input type='file'> the attach button opens; add multiple and accept as needed. Picked files are added (deduplicated) and the input is reset, so the same file can be picked again after removal.

send.description: Round send button with an aria-label. Disabled while there is no text and no file; author it disabled when the composer starts empty.

empty.description: Nothing to send: no text (whitespace does not count) and no file. The send button is disabled.

ready.description: There is text or at least one file; the send button is enabled.

enter.description: send = Enter sends and Shift+Enter breaks the line (chat); newline = Enter breaks the line and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends (long-form posts). Say which in visible help text for newline.

--composer-max-lines.description: How many lines the textarea grows to before it scrolls (custom property).

--composer-radius.description: Corner radius of the field (custom property).

--composer-send-radius.description: Corner radius of the send button (custom property).

keyboard.Enter: send (data-enter='send', the default); a new line with data-enter='newline'
keyboard.Enter during IME composition: commits the composition — never sends (isComposing / keyCode 229 are respected)
keyboard.Tab: move through the action buttons, the textarea, attach, each attachment's remove button and send
keyboard.Enter / Space on a chip's remove button: remove that file; focus moves to the next chip, or to the attach button

notes: The send button is disabled, not hidden, while there is nothing to send, so its position and name are stable.
After a send the composer clears and focus returns to the textarea, ready for the next message.
The attachments tray is a labelled list and a polite live region: adding a file announces its name and size.
With data-enter='newline', describe the send shortcut in visible text and point aria-describedby at it.
The root may also be a <form> (a no-JavaScript fallback that posts the message): the controller intercepts its submit and sends instead, so it never navigates.

faqir:send.description: Fires, cancelable, when the user sends (Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, the send button, a form submit, or send()): text is trimmed (inner newlines kept), files is an array of File. Call preventDefault() to keep the draft — say, when the network is down.
